en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: To acquaint students with the theory of agroforestry systems, to present practical examples, to present the historical context of landscape management. Agrolosnictví options in terms of CR and Central Europe.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Theory of Agroforesty (allowance 6/0) a.Social forestry, Definitions,b.Dividing of agroforestryc.History context of agroforestry2.Examples of Agroforestry practices (allowance 8/0) a.Agroforestry in Mediterraneanb.Agroforestry in tropicc.Alley cropping with Black Walnut3.Forestry and Agriculture - background of agroforestry (allowance 6/0) a.Community forestry, coppiceb.Agriculture in present4.Future of Agroforestry in Czech - silvoarable practice (allowance 8/0) a.SRC - short rotation coppiceb.legislation of woody plantations on arable landsc.subsidy
